description: Handle a neighbor conflict — noise, boundaries, parking, shared costs, pets — with a measured approach that de-escalates first and keeps a paper trail if it has to go formal. Use when asked to deal with a neighbor dispute, my neighbor is [too loud / over the boundary / blocking me], how do I talk to my neighbor about, or write a letter to my neighbor.
